description: Create the /evaluation/ directory with all evaluation scripts (utils.py, forecasting_eval.py, segmentation_eval.py, elasticity_eval.py, pricing_eval.py, llm_layer_eval.py, system_performance_eval.py, run_evaluation.py), requirements-eval.txt, and the evaluation/results/ directory. These scripts MEASURE the system only — no application code changes. Independent of FEAT-002 (pytest tests) and FEAT-003 (docs).
steps: Create /Users/kanishkbagzai/Revenue-Management-Project/revenue-management-project/evaluation/utils.py. Must define: EVAL_RANDOM_SEED=42, PIPELINE_ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent/'data-pipeline' (absolute), RESULTS_DIR=Path(__file__).resolve().parent/'results'. Functions: get_engine() (calls etl.db_connection.get_engine after inserting PIPELINE_ROOT to sys.path, SELECT-only by convention), get_gt_engine() (calls etl.db_connection.get_gt_engine), save_fig(fig, name), save_json(data, name), save_csv(df, name), ensure_results_dir(), load_metadata().

Create /Users/kanishkbagzai/Revenue-Management-Project/revenue-management-project/evaluation/forecasting_eval.py. Export run(args) function. Steps: (a) load metadata via utils.load_metadata(); (b) load forecast_features.csv via models.data_split.load_features(); (c) reproduce time_split using models.data_split.time_split(); (d) load XGBoost model via joblib.load(PIPELINE_ROOT/'models/artifacts/production_model.joblib'); (e) check for lr_model.joblib — if absent, refit DemandLinearRegression from models.baseline_model on split.X_train/y_train (in-memory only, do not save); (f) compute metrics via models.evaluate.compute_metrics and evaluate_per_product for both models; (g) compare to metadata metrics and report any difference; (h) query product table for categories via get_engine(); (i) compute per-category and per-product breakdowns; (j) analyse MAPE with zero/small actuals using EPSILON=1e-8 from models.evaluate; (k) produce 5 figures (actual vs predicted for best/median/worst product, residual histogram, feature importance) using matplotlib; (l) re-run leakage check by calling features.build_feature_table._run_leakage_test(df_features, df_weekly) after loading df_weekly via features.weekly_aggregation.load_weekly_aggregates(get_engine()); (m) save all outputs to evaluation/results/ as specified in plan.

Create /Users/kanishkbagzai/Revenue-Management-Project/revenue-management-project/evaluation/segmentation_eval.py. Export run(args). Steps: (a) compute RFM via segmentation.rfm.compute_rfm(get_engine()); (b) load ground truth via get_gt_engine() querying gt_customer_segment; (c) re-run k_search using segmentation.clustering functions (RANDOM_STATE=42, K_MIN=2, K_MAX=10) — do NOT save results to any pipeline path; (d) produce k=4 clustering for evaluation (same seed); (e) compute ARI, NMI, purity, confusion matrix vs true_segment; (f) produce per-segment RFM profile table; (g) run stability across seeds [0,1,2,42,99]; (h) produce 2 figures (elbow+silhouette combined, confusion matrix heatmap); (i) save all outputs to evaluation/results/.

Create /Users/kanishkbagzai/Revenue-Management-Project/revenue-management-project/evaluation/elasticity_eval.py. Export run(args). Steps: (a) load product_elasticity.csv from PIPELINE_ROOT/'data/elasticity/product_elasticity.csv'; (b) load true_elasticity from get_gt_engine() querying gt_product_elasticity; (c) merge on product_id; (d) compute MAE, RMSE, Pearson, Spearman, sign agreement; (e) compute per-category breakdown; (f) identify worst estimates (|estimated-true|>0.3), diagnose using r_squared/n_obs/reliable_flag/unreliable_reasons; (g) produce scatter figure; (h) save outputs to evaluation/results/.

Create /Users/kanishkbagzai/Revenue-Management-Project/revenue-management-project/evaluation/pricing_eval.py. Export run(args). Steps: (a) query pricing_recommendation from get_engine(); (b) check constraint compliance for each row where binding_constraint!='NO_FEASIBLE_PRICE' using MIN_MARGIN_PCT=0.10 and MAX_PRICE_CHANGE_PCT=0.15 from pricing.pricing_config; (c) compute price change direction distribution (INCREASE/DECREASE/KEEP); (d) merge with elasticity CSV and compute Pearson correlation of estimated elasticity vs change_pct, also vs true_elasticity from get_gt_engine(); (e) verify determinism by querying recommendations twice and asserting equality; (f) OPTIONAL (--with-gt-sim flag): load gt_product_elasticity and product base_demand/base_price, compute expected_weekly_units(price)=baseline_demand*(price/current_price)**true_elasticity for current and recommended prices, report average uplift and share where recommended>=current; (g) produce 1-2 figures; (h) save outputs to evaluation/results/.

Create /Users/kanishkbagzai/Revenue-Management-Project/revenue-management-project/evaluation/llm_layer_eval.py. Export run(args). Steps: (a) always run: prompt construction validation using explanations.prompts.build_prompt; (b) always run: failure handling simulation using Scripted LLM client from test_explanations.py pattern (LLMError scenarios); (c) always run: guardrail self-test on stored explanations from llm_explanation table via get_engine(); (d) --with-llm only: numeric consistency check on up to 30 products using LLM API; (e) --with-llm only: latency stats; (f) save outputs to evaluation/results/.

Create /Users/kanishkbagzai/Revenue-Management-Project/revenue-management-project/evaluation/system_performance_eval.py. Export run(args). Steps: (a) time XGBoost and LR training (in-memory refit, models NOT saved) using time.perf_counter; (b) collect API response times for 9 endpoints with 10 requests each (skip if backend not running); (c) collect hardware info via platform and os; (d) build parameter table from config imports; (e) save outputs to evaluation/results/.

Create /Users/kanishkbagzai/Revenue-Management-Project/revenue-management-project/evaluation/run_evaluation.py. Implement CLI with --list, --only <area>, --with-llm flags. Areas: forecasting, segmentation, elasticity, pricing, llm_layer, system_performance. Import each module and call run(args). Write evaluation/results/evaluation_summary.json after all areas complete.
